title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 31 ]

items.text: Their original plan was for the balloon to fly across theArctic Ocean.
The problem is where to live.
The best way is never to see him again.
My plan is to build a house here.
All I want is for somebody to be thinking about me.
The purpose is to prepare children for school.
Our sole wish was to preserve peace.
The moment was right for them to set up an independent country.
I didn't know when to do it.
I didn't know with whom to go.
He likes it very much to read fictions.
I find it difficult to solve this problem.
I find it difficult for him to solve the problem.
I didn't know how to drive a car then.
I don't know when and where to go.
I think it easy for you to pass the examination.
